<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  // === True for Closure, False for open ===
  const CLOSURE_ACTIVE = true;

  // === Load Closure Status from ltca_closure.csv ===
  fetch("data/resources/ltca_closure.csv")
    .then(response => response.text())
    .then(text => {
      const rows = text.trim().split("\n").map(r => r.split(","));
      const headers = rows.shift().map(h => h.trim());
      const startIdx = headers.findIndex(h => /start/i.test(h));
      const endIdx = headers.findIndex(h => /end/i.test(h));

      if (startIdx === -1 || endIdx === -1) {
        console.error("Start or End column not found in closure CSV");
        return;
      }

      // Parse rows into date objects
      const parsed = rows
        .map(r => ({
          start: new Date(r[startIdx]),
          end: new Date(r[endIdx]),
        }))
        .filter(d => !isNaN(d.start) && !isNaN(d.end))
        .sort((a, b) => b.end - a.end);

      const recent = parsed[0];

      if (!recent) {
        console.warn("No valid closure records found.");
        return;
      }

      console.log("Latest closure record:", recent.start, "→", recent.end);

      const now = new Date();
      const banner = document.querySelector(".status-banner");
      const textEl = document.querySelector(".status-text");
      const dateEl = document.getElementById("closure-date");
      const descEl = document.getElementById("closure-description");

      // Manual banner switch
      banner.classList.remove("success", "alert-active", "alert-upcoming");

      if (CLOSURE_ACTIVE) {
        banner.classList.add("alert-active");
        textEl.textContent = "Closure is in effect";
      } else {
        banner.classList.add("success");
        textEl.textContent = "No closure in effect";
      }

      // Update date
      if (dateEl) {
        const opts = { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" };
        dateEl.textContent =
          "Updated " + now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, opts);
      }

      /*
      // Default state
      banner.classList.remove("alert-active", "alert-upcoming");
      banner.classList.add("success");
      textEl.textContent = "No closure in effect";

      // Determine closure state
      if (now < recent.start) {
        banner.classList.remove("success");
        banner.classList.add("alert-upcoming");
        textEl.textContent = "Closure Alert: Will take effect soon";
      } else if (now >= recent.start && now <= recent.end) {
        banner.classList.remove("success");
        banner.classList.add("alert-active");
        textEl.textContent = "Closure is in effect";
      }

      // Descriptive paragraph
      if (descEl) {
        const startStr = recent.start.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
          month: "long",
          day: "numeric",
          year: "numeric",
        });
        const endStr = recent.end.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
          month: "long",
          day: "numeric",
          year: "numeric",
        });
        const postStr = recent.end.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
          month: "numeric",
          day: "numeric",
          year: "numeric"
        });

        if (now < recent.start) {
          descEl.textContent =
            `NMFS will prohibit fishing with drift gillnets (DGN) in the Pacific Loggerhead Conservation Area from ${startStr} to ${endStr}. *(Posted ${postStr})*`;
        } else if (now >= recent.start && now <= recent.end) {
          descEl.textContent =
            `NMFS is prohibiting fishing with drift gillnets (DGN) in the Pacific Loggerhead Conservation Area. The closure began on ${startStr} and remains in effect until ${endStr}. *(Posted ${postStr})*`;
        } else {
          descEl.textContent =
            `NMFS has reopened the Pacific Loggerhead Conservation Area (LCA) to fishing with drift gillnets (DGN). The LCA had been closed from ${startStr} to ${endStr}. *(Posted ${postStr})*`;
        }
      }
      */
    })
    .catch(err => console.error("Error loading closure CSV:", err));


  // === Load El Niño JSON ===
  fetch("data/json/elnino_last.json")
    .then(resp => resp.json())
    .then(data => {
      const ninoStatus = document.getElementById("nino-status");
      const ninoDate = document.getElementById("nino-date");
      const ninoSynopsis = document.getElementById("nino-synopsis");

      if (ninoStatus) {
        ninoStatus.textContent = data.status || "Not available";
      }

      if (ninoDate) {
        ninoDate.textContent = data.date_print || "Not available";
      }

      if (ninoSynopsis) {
        ninoSynopsis.textContent =
          data.synopsis?.trim() || "Not available";
      }
    })
    .catch(err => console.error("Error loading El Niño JSON:", err));


  // === Load Marine Heatwave JSON ===
  fetch("data/json/heatwave.json")
    .then(resp => resp.json())
    .then(data => {
      const hwPeriod = document.getElementById("heat-period");
      const hwDate = document.getElementById("heat-date");
      const hwLink = document.getElementById("heat-link");
      const regions = document.getElementById("heat-regions");

      if (hwPeriod) {
        hwPeriod.textContent = data.heat_period || "Not available";
      }

      if (hwDate) {
        hwDate.textContent = data.heat_date || "Not available";
      }

      if (hwLink && data.source_url) {
        hwLink.href = data.source_url;
      }

      if (regions) {
        if (
          data.pacific_regions &&
          Object.keys(data.pacific_regions).length > 0
        ) {
          regions.innerHTML = "";

          Object.entries(data.pacific_regions).forEach(([region, forecast]) => {
            const p = document.createElement("p");

            p.innerHTML = `
              <strong>${region}:</strong>
              ${forecast}
            `;

            regions.appendChild(p);
          });
        } else {
          regions.innerHTML =
            "<p>No Pacific forecasts available.</p>";
        }
      }
    })
    .catch(err => console.error("Error loading Heatwave JSON:", err));


  // === Load and render SST Table ===
  const container = document.getElementById("sst-table-container");

  if (container) {
    fetch("data/json/latest.json")
      .then(resp => resp.json())
      .then(data => {
        const keys = Object.keys(data).sort(
          (a, b) => Number(b.slice(1)) - Number(a.slice(1))
        );

        const months = keys.map(k => data[k].month || "");
        const sstVals = keys.map(k => parseFloat(data[k].sst));
        const anomVals = keys.map(k => parseFloat(data[k].anom));

        // Format values safely when a month is missing.
        function formatValue(value, unit, isAnomaly = false) {
          if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
            return "N/A";
          }

          if (unit === "F") {
            const converted = isAnomaly
              ? value * 9 / 5
              : value * 9 / 5 + 32;

            return converted.toFixed(1);
          }

          return value.toFixed(1);
        }

        const table = document.createElement("table");
        table.className = "table table-condensed table-striped";

        // Header
        const thead = document.createElement("thead");
        const headerRow = document.createElement("tr");

        headerRow.appendChild(document.createElement("th"));

        months.forEach(m => {
          const th = document.createElement("th");
          th.textContent = m;
          headerRow.appendChild(th);
        });

        thead.appendChild(headerRow);
        table.appendChild(thead);

        // Body
        const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");

        const tempRow = document.createElement("tr");
        const tempLabel = document.createElement("td");
        tempLabel.textContent = "Temperature";
        tempRow.appendChild(tempLabel);

        sstVals.forEach(v => {
          const td = document.createElement("td");
          td.textContent = formatValue(v, "C");
          tempRow.appendChild(td);
        });

        tbody.appendChild(tempRow);

        const anomRow = document.createElement("tr");
        const anomLabel = document.createElement("td");
        anomLabel.textContent = "Anomaly";
        anomRow.appendChild(anomLabel);

        anomVals.forEach(v => {
          const td = document.createElement("td");
          td.textContent = formatValue(v, "C", true);
          td.style.fontWeight = "bold";

          if (Number.isFinite(v)) {
            td.style.color =
              v > 0 ? "red" : v < 0 ? "blue" : "black";
          }

          anomRow.appendChild(td);
        });

        tbody.appendChild(anomRow);

        table.appendChild(tbody);
        container.innerHTML = "";
        container.appendChild(table);

        // °C/°F toggle logic
        const radios = document.querySelectorAll(
          "input[name='temp-unit']"
        );

        radios.forEach(radio => {
          radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
            const temps = table.querySelectorAll(
              "tbody tr:first-child td:not(:first-child)"
            );

            const anoms = table.querySelectorAll(
              "tbody tr:last-child td:not(:first-child)"
            );

            temps.forEach((td, i) => {
              td.textContent = formatValue(sstVals[i], radio.value);
            });

            anoms.forEach((td, i) => {
              td.textContent = formatValue(
                anomVals[i],
                radio.value,
                true
              );
            });
          });
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error("Error loading SST table JSON:", err);

        container.innerHTML =
          "<p style='color:red;'>Error loading temperature data.</p>";
      });
  }


  // === Load TOTAL Loggerhead Index JSON ===
  fetch("data/json/web_data.json")
    .then(resp => resp.json())
    .then(data => {
      const fcEl = document.getElementById("total-fcdate");
      const stEl = document.getElementById("total-status");
      const idxEl = document.getElementById("total-index");
      const updEl = document.getElementById("total-updated");

      if (fcEl) {
        fcEl.textContent = data.fc_date || "Not available";
      }

      if (stEl) {
        stEl.textContent = data.alert || "Not available";
      }

      if (idxEl) {
        idxEl.textContent = data.new_index || "Not available";
      }

      if (updEl) {
        updEl.textContent = data.update_date || "Not available";
      }
    })
    .catch(err => console.error("Error loading TOTAL index JSON:", err));


  // === SST & ANOMALY SLIDERS ===
  // Display available maps from the last 6 completed calendar months.
  // Missing monthly images are excluded from slider navigation.

  const sstImgEl = document.getElementById("sst-dash-image");
  const sstPrevBtn = document.querySelector(".sst-slider .prev");
  const sstNextBtn = document.querySelector(".sst-slider .next");

  const anomImgEl = document.getElementById("anom-image");
  const anomPrevBtn = document.querySelector(".anom-slider .prev");
  const anomNextBtn = document.querySelector(".anom-slider .next");

  const sstYearLabels = document.querySelectorAll("#sst-year");

  const today = new Date();
  const numMonths = 6;

  // Build calendar-month candidates, oldest to newest.
  const candidateMonths = [];

  for (let i = numMonths; i >= 1; i--) {
    const d = new Date(
      today.getFullYear(),
      today.getMonth() - i,
      16
    );

    const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
    const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    const stamp = `${yyyy}${mm}16`;

    candidateMonths.push({
      label: d.toLocaleString(undefined, {
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric"
      }),
      year: yyyy,
      sst: `data/images/sst_${stamp}.png`,
      anom: `data/images/anom_${stamp}.png`
    });
  }

  // Check whether an image exists and can be loaded.
  function imageExists(src) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const img = new Image();

      img.onload = () => resolve(true);
      img.onerror = () => resolve(false);

      img.src = src;
    });
  }

  // Set up a slider using only the available images.
  function initializeMapSlider(imgElement, prevBtn, nextBtn, images) {
    if (!imgElement) return;

    let currentIndex = images.length - 1;

    function updateSlider() {
      if (images.length === 0) {
        imgElement.style.display = "none";

        if (prevBtn) prevBtn.style.opacity = 0.5;
        if (nextBtn) nextBtn.style.opacity = 0.5;

        return;
      }

      imgElement.style.display = "";
      imgElement.src = images[currentIndex];

      if (prevBtn) {
        prevBtn.style.opacity = currentIndex === 0 ? 0.5 : 1;
      }

      if (nextBtn) {
        nextBtn.style.opacity =
          currentIndex === images.length - 1 ? 0.5 : 1;
      }
    }

    if (prevBtn) {
      prevBtn.addEventListener("click", e => {
        e.preventDefault();

        if (currentIndex > 0) {
          currentIndex--;
          updateSlider();
        }
      });
    }

    if (nextBtn) {
      nextBtn.addEventListener("click", e => {
        e.preventDefault();

        if (currentIndex < images.length - 1) {
          currentIndex++;
          updateSlider();
        }
      });
    }

    updateSlider();
  }

  // Check both SST and anomaly maps for each month.
  Promise.all(
    candidateMonths.map(async month => {
      const [sstAvailable, anomAvailable] = await Promise.all([
        imageExists(month.sst),
        imageExists(month.anom)
      ]);

      return {
        ...month,
        sstAvailable,
        anomAvailable
      };
    })
  )
    .then(months => {
      const sstMonths = months.filter(m => m.sstAvailable);
      const anomMonths = months.filter(m => m.anomAvailable);

      const sstImages = sstMonths.map(m => m.sst);
      const anomImages = anomMonths.map(m => m.anom);

      // Determine the year range from available maps.
      const availableMonths = months.filter(
        m => m.sstAvailable || m.anomAvailable
      );

      if (sstYearLabels.length > 0 && availableMonths.length > 0) {
        const firstYear = availableMonths[0].year;
        const lastYear = availableMonths[availableMonths.length - 1].year;

        const labelText = firstYear === lastYear
          ? String(firstYear)
          : `${firstYear}–${lastYear}`;

        sstYearLabels.forEach(el => {
          el.textContent = labelText;
        });
      }

      // Initialize sliders using only valid image paths.
      initializeMapSlider(
        sstImgEl,
        sstPrevBtn,
        sstNextBtn,
        sstImages
      );

      initializeMapSlider(
        anomImgEl,
        anomPrevBtn,
        anomNextBtn,
        anomImages
      );

      // Log missing months for debugging.
      months.forEach(month => {
        if (!month.sstAvailable) {
          console.warn(`Missing SST map: ${month.sst}`);
        }

        if (!month.anomAvailable) {
          console.warn(`Missing anomaly map: ${month.anom}`);
        }
      });
    })
    .catch(err => {
      console.error("Error initializing map sliders:", err);
    });


  // === Date update (top banner) ===
  const dateEl = document.querySelector(".status-date");

  if (dateEl) {
    const now = new Date();
    const options = {
      year: "numeric",
      month: "long",
      day: "numeric"
    };

    dateEl.textContent = now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, options);
  }

});
</script>


:::
